title: Story
text:
A common debate among gamers is whether modern video games demand more time to finish than older titles. Using data from the top 1,000 games on HowLongToBeat, we can track main story duration across release years.









Most games consistently center around 10 to 20 hours for their main story, with a modest upward trend in average length in recent years.
